{{Top|leg}}
'''''T-SE''''' was a group of three [[Utility Tug/Legends|Utility Tug]]s used by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebels]]. The tugs were to deliver pilots to [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|shuttles]] [[Revt]] to defend a supply depot conisting of [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|Y-wings]], shuttles, two [[Delta-class DX-9 stormtrooper transport|stormtrooper transports]] ''[[Bultz]]'' and three [[Class-A cargo container|containers]] ''[[Duce]]'' from [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[TIE/IN interceptor/Legends|TIE Interceptors]] and [[TIE/sa tactical bomber/Legends|Bombers]]. The tugs were all destroyed in the battle. The battle was then recreated and adapted in the [[Combat chamber]] to train future [[TIE pilot|pilots]] such as [[Maarek Stele/Legends|Maarek Stele]].
